texto: Interpret earlier action, hypothesis and evaluation from the verb form chosen. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: recognise which event comes before another, whether the author raises a possibility, and which verb takes the subjunctive. In this passage, «rapport» means «report».
